options_time_range.name: options_time_range
options_time_range.value: "options"."end_time" IS NULL OR ("options"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "options"."end_time" > "options"."start_time")

options_times_on_single_date.name: options_times_on_single_date
options_times_on_single_date.value: "options"."end_date" IS NULL OR ("options"."start_time" IS NULL AND "options"."end_time" IS NULL)
